summary: Added launch_queue_persist.py: append-only JSONL persistence + read-back audit for the disabled-by-default launch_queue_contract's LaunchRequest/LaunchDecision/ProcessLogEntry schemas. persist_intent()/persist_transition() call the unmodified contract (enqueue_intent -> evaluate_launch -> build_log_entry) and append one scrubbed record per call; the log file is opened in append mode only and is never truncated or rewritten. With both env gates unset (default) every persisted record's decision/to_state is blocked_launch_disabled; forcing BOTH AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH and AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES on still yields blocked_launch_disabled records because no launcher is implemented (LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED stays a constant False in the contract module). No subprocess/exec/fork/spawn/system/popen/shell/network code exists anywhere in the new module. Secrets never leak: persisted env_gate_status carries only the two explicit gate NAMEs mapped to '<set>'/'<unset>' tokens, and _scrub_entry drops any stray top-level key outside the frozen ProcessLogEntry schema as defense in depth.

invariant.persistence_never_changes_the_permitted_: persist_transition/persist_intent call evaluate_launch() unmodified; permitted stays False regardless of env gate state because no launcher exists in launch_queue_contract
invariant.append_only: log file opened with mode='a' only; no code path opens with 'w' or truncates

env.precedence: explicit log_path kwarg > AIWORKHUB_LAUNCH_QUEUE_LOG_PATH > repo-root default

public_api.resolve_log_path(repo=None, log_path=Non: -> Path, pure, never opens the file
public_api.persist_transition(request, decision=Non: -> dict, appends one scrubbed ProcessLogEntry record; decision defaults to evaluate_launch(request)
public_api.persist_intent(task_id=, runner=, topic=: -> dict(request, decision, persisted_entry); full pure enqueue->evaluate->persist pipeline
public_api.read_persisted_log(repo=None, log_path=N: -> dict summary (total_entries, entries_by_decision, entries_by_to_state, all_blocked_launch_disabled, last_entries); read-only
public_api.contract_summary(): -> dict, pure introspection of this persistence module's contract shape
public_api._scrub_entry(entry): -> dict restricted to the frozen ProcessLogEntry schema; internal defense-in-depth helper exercised directly by the test

neural_bridge_note: This module is a deterministic evidence/audit substrate only (append-only JSONL persistence of an already-pure contract's schemas); it decides no capability. Future adapter/runner/topic launch selection remains scoped to the learned routing + abstain policy tracked as MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1 -- no regex/keyword cognition becomes launch or persistence authority here.
no_launch_code_marker: This module and its test contain NO process-launch code: no subprocess import, no child-process spawn, no os-level fork/exec/spawn/system/popen, no shell invocation, no network/API call. Launch/process code arrives only in the gated Phase-2 follow-up (CLAUDE_TASK_MCP_ORCH_GATED_ENABLEMENT_B106_V1) behind all launch_preconditions.
